Requirement:
Healthcare Portal — Polished Requirement Specification

Functional Requirements
1. The system shall allow new users to complete registration.
2. The system shall end access if registration fails.
3. The system shall allow registered users to sign in.
4. The system shall provide access to available facilities after signing in.
5. The system shall allow users to read news and expert content.
6. The system shall provide health-related information allowing users to check symptoms or use fitness checking options.
7. The system shall allow users to continue using the system or finish the session after viewing a result.
8. The system shall process and validate insurance for available finance-related services.
9. The system shall check payment with insurance for doctor consultations and complete the payment process.
10. The system shall allow users to select payment methods (cash or insurance) for drug and supplement purchases.
11. The system shall inform users about cash payment details if chosen as the payment method.
12. The system shall complete the payment process for insurance-based payments.
13. The system shall collect user feedback after service completion.
14. The system shall log out users at the end of their session.

Invalid PlantUML:
@startuml
title UML State Machine Diagram for Healthcare Portal

[*] --> Register

state Register {
  [*] --> Registered : [registration successful]
  Registered --> Login : [user signed in]
}

state Login {
  [*] --> Dashboard : [user logged in]
}

state Dashboard <<choice>>
Dashboard --> PatientDashboard : [patient user]
Dashboard --> HealthWorkerDashboard : [health worker user]
Dashboard --> GovernmentDashboard : [government official]

state PatientDashboard
PatientDashboard : entry / patient dashboard displayed
PatientDashboard : do / read news and expert content
PatientDashboard : do / check symptoms or use fitness checking options
PatientDashboard : exit / continue using system or finish session

state HealthWorkerDashboard
HealthWorkerDashboard : entry / health worker dashboard displayed
HealthWorkerDashboard : do / process insurance for available finance-related services
HealthWorkerDashboard : do / check payment with insurance for doctor consultations and complete the payment process
HealthWorkerDashboard : do / allow users to select payment methods (cash or insurance) for drug and supplement purchases
HealthWorkerDashboard : exit / continue using system or finish session

state GovernmentDashboard
GovernmentDashboard : entry / government dashboard displayed
GovernmentDashboard : do / collect user feedback after service completion
GovernmentDashboard : exit / log out user at the end of their session

state Logout
Logout : entry / log out user
Logout : do / complete logout process
Logout : exit / successfully logged out

Register --> Login : [registration failed]
Login --> Dashboard : [invalid credentials]

@enduml

Validation Errors:
- multiple_initial_state_transitions
- missing_final_state_transition
- orphan_state

Relevant Rule:
- multiple_initial_state_transitions: A valid state diagram should have one clear top-level initial transition. Remove or restructure extra top-level [*] transitions.
- missing_final_state_transition: A valid state diagram must include at least one final transition from a natural terminal state to [*].
- orphan_state: Every requirement-supported state must have reasonable incoming or outgoing transitions. Unsupported orphan states should be omitted.

PatientDashboard : entry / patient dashboard displayed
PatientDashboard : do / read news and expert content
PatientDashboard : do / check symptoms or use fitness checking options
PatientDashboard : exit / continue using system or finish session

Dashboard --> HealthWorkerDashboard : [health worker user]
HealthWorkerDashboard : entry / health worker dashboard displayed
HealthWorkerDashboard : do / process insurance for available finance-related services
HealthWorkerDashboard : do / check payment with insurance for doctor consultations and complete the payment process
HealthWorkerDashboard : do / allow users to select payment methods (cash or insurance) for drug and supplement purchases
HealthWorkerDashboard : exit / continue using system or finish session

Dashboard --> GovernmentDashboard : [government official]
GovernmentDashboard : entry / government dashboard displayed

Requirement:
Alarm Clock — Polished Requirement Specification

Functional Requirements
1. The system shall be in an off state initially.
2. The system shall support when the user sets an alarm time, the system shall activate the alarm.
3. The system shall ensure that the user shall be able to turn off the activated alarm.
4. The system shall support when the current time matches the set alarm time, the system shall start ringing the alarm.
5. The system shall ensure that once the alarm is ringing, the user shall be able to stop it.
6. The system shall support after stopping the alarm, the system shall remain active for the next scheduled alarm time.

Invalid PlantUML:
@startuml
[*] --> Off

state Off {
  [*] --> Idle
  Idle --> Off : turn off
}

state Idle {
  [*] --> SetAlarm : set alarm
  SetAlarm --> AlarmSet : alarm set
}

state AlarmSet {
  AlarmSet --> Ringing : alarm time reached
  Ringing --> Off : turn off
  Ringing --> Stopped : stop alarm
  Stopped --> Idle : alarm stopped
}

Ringing --> Ringing : keep ringing
Stopped --> Idle : alarm stopped
@enduml

- duplicate_transitions_detected: Duplicate transitions should be removed or merged into one transition with a clear label.

Requirement:
Safehome Security Function — Polished Requirement Specification

Functional Requirements
1. The system shall check if everything is working upon power-on.
2. The system shall stop if there is a problem during startup.
3. The system shall become ready to use if everything is fine during startup.
4. The system shall allow the user to reset it when it is ready to use.
5. The system shall allow the user to activate it when it is ready to use.
6. The system shall allow the user to turn it off when it is ready to use.
7. The system shall start monitoring if it is activated.
8. The system shall start the alarm and send alerts if a sensor is triggered during monitoring.
9. The system shall continue monitoring if it turns out to be a false alarm or the time ends.
10. The system shall stop and return to normal when the user enters the password at any time.

Invalid PlantUML:
@startuml
[*] --> Idle

state Idle {
  [*] --> ReadyToUse
  ReadyToUse --> [*]
}

state ReadyToUse {
  ReadyToUse --> Reset : reset
  ReadyToUse --> Activate : activate
  ReadyToUse --> TurnOff : turnOff
  ReadyToUse --> Monitoring : monitor
}

state Monitoring {
  Monitoring --> Alarm : sensorTriggered
  Monitoring --> Monitoring : falseAlarm
  Monitoring --> Monitoring : timeEnds
  Monitoring --> [*] : passwordEntry
}

state Alarm {
  Alarm --> [*] : passwordEntry
}

@enduml
